_documentation.purpose: Selects which packages and setup components the install scripts (setup-win.ps1, setup-mac.sh) install. Edit this file before running an installer.
_documentation.defaults: The committed defaults encode the repo owner's preferences: Windows-centric, VS Code as editor (no Neovim config), no GPG/commit-signing machinery, standard OpenSSH agent, Go/Node/Python toolchains, oh-my-posh prompt with fzf keybindings but no eza/bat aliases, and none of the original author's personal apps. Note the tracked .zshrc still requires gnupg, so on a Mac without it validation rejects this config; re-enable gpg and remove the gpg4win exclusion there.
_documentation.components: Set a component to false to skip it. A missing key defaults to true, so deleting this file installs everything.
_documentation.packages: packages.exclude lists package names to skip. Names match the 'name' field (or the bare string) of entries in packages.json, including admin_packages and mac_extras entries.

component_reference.developer_mode: Windows admin phase: machine-wide execution policy and the Developer Mode registry key. The symlink components below require Developer Mode or elevation.
component_reference.git: ~/.gitconfig and per-OS include symlinks; macOS also runs 'git lfs install'. Also prompts once for user.name/user.email/signing and writes them to ~/.gitconfig-user.
component_reference.ssh: Replaces ~/.ssh/config with a symlink to ssh_config.
component_reference.gpg: GPG and gpg-agent configuration; Windows also registers the gpg-connect-agent logon task.
component_reference.claude: Claude Code: statusline symlink, installer, and statusLine setting (Windows).
component_reference.vscode: Windows: VS Code via winget and the EDITOR=code user environment variable.
component_reference.packages: scoop/Homebrew package installation, including bucket adds and the Homebrew bootstrap itself.
component_reference.go: Go toolchain (goup on Windows, goenv on macOS) plus golangci-lint and staticcheck.
component_reference.terminal: Windows Terminal defaults: pwsh profile, MesloLGM Nerd Font, bar cursor.
component_reference.shell: Shell profile. Windows: managed pwsh profile block (oh-my-posh, posh-git, PSFzf keybindings). macOS: oh-my-zsh install and the ~/.zshrc symlink.
component_reference.cli_aliases: Windows: aliases ls/ll/la/tree to eza and cat to bat inside the managed profile block. The tools themselves install with the package set regardless.
component_reference.node: corepack install and enable via npm.
component_reference.repo_remote: Windows: re-points this repository's origin remote at the $DepotURL defined in setup-win.ps1.
component_reference.git_tools_cleanup: Windows: deletes vim.exe and gpg.exe from the Git for Windows install so scoop's neovim and gpg4win win on PATH.
